_comment_header: PRESET SCHEMA TEMPLATE - Shows all available configuration options
_comment_purpose: This file serves as documentation and template for creating presets
_comment_usage: During build, only non-empty/non-default values are used from actual presets

metadata.name: Preset Name
metadata.description: Detailed description of what this preset configures
metadata.author: Author name or organization

output._comment_outputPath: Directory where ISO and logs will be saved (relative or absolute)

packages._comment_removeList: List of AppX packages to remove. Examples: Microsoft.BingNews, Microsoft.BingWeather, Microsoft.GamingApp, Microsoft.GetHelp, Microsoft.Getstarted, Microsoft.Microsoft3DViewer, Microsoft.MicrosoftOfficeHub, Microsoft.MicrosoftSolitaireCollection, Microsoft.MixedReality.Portal, Microsoft.Office.OneNote, Microsoft.People, Microsoft.SkypeApp, Microsoft.Todos, Microsoft.WindowsAlarms, Microsoft.WindowsCamera, Microsoft.windowscommunicationsapps, Microsoft.WindowsFeedbackHub, Microsoft.WindowsMaps, Microsoft.WindowsSoundRecorder, Microsoft.Xbox.TCUI, Microsoft.XboxApp, Microsoft.XboxGameOverlay, Microsoft.XboxGamingOverlay, Microsoft.XboxIdentityProvider, Microsoft.XboxSpeechToTextOverlay, Microsoft.YourPhone, Microsoft.ZuneMusic, Microsoft.ZuneVideo
packages._comment_keepList: List of AppX packages to explicitly keep. Examples: Microsoft.WindowsStore, Microsoft.WindowsTerminal, Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller

features._comment: Windows 11 system requirement bypass features (LabConfig registry)
features._comment_bypassSystemRequirements: Master toggle for all bypass features below
features._comment_bypassDiskCheck: Bypass disk type requirement - SSD check (HKLM\SYSTEM\Setup\LabConfig\BypassDiskCheck)
features._comment_bypassUpgradeTPMCPUCheck: Allow in-place upgrades on unsupported TPM/CPU (HKLM\SYSTEM\Setup\MoSetup\AllowUpgradesWithUnsupportedTPMOrCPU)
features._comment_disableCompatibilityAppraiser: Disable compatibility appraiser/gating (HKLM\SYSTEM\Setup CmdLine, OOBEInProgress, SetupPhase)
features._comment_compactOS: Enable CompactOS (compressed system binaries). Disabled by default due to VM/disk compatibility risks

scripts._comment_buildVerification: Run built-in verification script on first login to check settings applied correctly
scripts._comment_runOnce: One-time login scripts (string or array of PowerShell script paths). Executed at first user logon in order

optimization._comment_componentCleanup: Run DISM component cleanup (removes superseded components)
optimization._comment_resetBase: Reset base of superseded components (cannot be uninstalled after this)
optimization._comment_removeWinSxSBackups: Remove backup files from WinSxS folder (cannot be uninstalled after this)

drivers._comment_path: Path to folder containing .inf driver files (relative or absolute)

updates._comment: Windows Update package injection (not yet implemented)

oem._comment_oemPath: Optional root OEM folder to copy into ISO (staged at sources/$OEM$/)
oem._comment_copy: List of files/folders to copy into install via $OEM$\\$1 (destination relative to C:\\)

unattended._comment_timezone: Windows timezone name (e.g., 'Pacific Standard Time', 'Eastern Standard Time', 'UTC')
unattended._comment_locale: System locale (e.g., en-US, de-DE, ja-JP, fr-FR)

userAccount._comment: Default administrator account created during installation
userAccount._comment_username: Username for the local administrator account
userAccount._comment_password: Password (plain text - will be set during install)

privacy._comment_disableTelemetry: Disable Windows telemetry and diagnostic data collection (HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection)
privacy._comment_disableAppSuggestions: Disable app suggestions in Start menu, notifications, and lock screen (HKCU\ContentDeliveryManager)

security._comment_disableUac: Disable User Account Control (NOT RECOMMENDED - security risk)
security._comment_disableSmartScreen: Disable Windows SmartScreen filter for apps/files/websites
security._comment_disableVirtualizationBasedSecur: Disable VBS/HVCI (memory integrity) - improves performance but reduces security
security._comment_disableMemoryIntegrity: Explicit flag to disable Core Isolation / Memory Integrity (maps to HVCI/VBS registry)
security._comment_enableUsbInstallation: Allow installs to proceed when removable/USB device policies are present (relaxes device install restrictions)

ui._comment_showFileExtensions: Show file extensions in File Explorer (HKCU\Explorer\Advanced\HideFileExt)
ui._comment_hideFiles: Hidden file visibility: 'none' (show all), 'hidden' (hide hidden), 'hiddenSystem' (hide hidden+system)
ui._comment_disableWidgets: Disable widgets/news and interests on taskbar (HKLM\Policies\Dsh\AllowNewsAndInterests)
ui._comment_launchToThisPC: Open File Explorer to 'This PC' instead of 'Quick Access' (HKCU\Explorer\Advanced\LaunchTo)
ui._comment_disableWindowsConsumerFeatures: Disable consumer features: app suggestions, tips, ads (HKLM\CloudContent\DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures)
ui._comment_emptyStartPins: Remove all pinned items from Start menu (ConfigureStartPins)
ui._comment_disableBingResults: Disable Bing web results in Windows Search (HKCU\Explorer\DisableSearchBoxSuggestions)

performance._comment_enableLongPaths: Enable NTFS long path support >260 characters (HKLM\FileSystem\LongPathsEnabled)
performance._comment_disableFastStartup: Disable fast startup/hybrid shutdown - improves dual-boot compatibility (HKLM\Power\HiberbootEnabled)
performance._comment_disableHibernation: Disable hibernation to free up disk space (removes hiberfil.sys)
performance._comment_disableSystemRestore: Disable System Restore to free up disk space (HKLM\Policies\SR\DisableSR)
performance._comment_allowPowerShellScripts: Set PowerShell execution policy to RemoteSigned (HKLM\PowerShell\ExecutionPolicy)

development._comment_enableDeveloperMode: Enable Windows Developer Mode (sideloading, device portal, etc.)
development._comment_enableWSL: Enable Windows Subsystem for Linux (requires restart)
development._comment_allowPowerShellScripts_dev: Alias for allowPowerShellScripts when specified under development

browser._comment_disableEdgeStartupBoost: Disable Edge startup boost background service

postInstall._comment: Post-installation configuration (runs after Windows setup completes)
postInstall._comment_packagesJsonPath: Path to packages.json for winget package installation (relative or absolute)
